name: Gassal
s: Gassal tells the story of a gassal who pursues the question "Who will wash me when I die?" and tells the story of Baki, who decides to reshape his life after coming face to face with death. Living side by side with death as a gassal, Baki discovers new meanings about life while looking for someone to wash him. paragraphs.text: Gassal (The Late Offices) is a Turkish drama and comedy web series produced in 2024 and released on TRT's streaming platform tabii. Ahmet Kural stars in the lead role joined by Hande Soral in the second season.
